data.reasoning: Both models reviewed the PKGBUILD, wrapper script, and desktop file, finding them to be standard and safe. data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 API error when auditing .SRCINFO, resulting in an inconclusive package verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and returned safe.
learnings: Transient API errors on non-executable metadata files like .SRCINFO should not force an overall inconclusive verdict if the core executable files (PKGBUILD, install scripts) are safely audited. The tool should handle such errors gracefully.
HTML entity encoding artifacts (e.g., ", &gt;) in file contents can confuse models. The audit tool should decode HTML entities before passing file contents to the LLM to prevent misinterpretation.
